row:
Just a licensed massage therapist who loves her job and made a youtube channel about it!

My goal with this channel is to teach and show massage techniques that are both effective and easy to do at home for various ailments and pains. Feel free to follow these techniques in addition to any therapy you may be receiving, or in a pinch if your scheduled massage isn't for a few more days or weeks---and you need help NOW!!
(We've all had those days)

Feel free to explore my channel, but don't get discouraged if you can't find what you're looking for yet; I'm always making more videos!

All my love,
Katrina
